༄༅/ /snyan brgyud chung ngu ye shes rang snang bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snyan brgyud chung ngu ye shes rang snang bzhugs so/ /

zab cing rgya che bla med snying po'i don/ /gsal bar ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /thig le mchog gsang snyan brgyud rim gsum las/ khrid du bsdebs te ye shes rang snang bkod/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i sde gsum las/ /man ngag sde la'ang phyi nang gsang ba'i skor/ /snying tig rang 'grail 'od gsal mngon sum las/ /yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud nyams len bri/ /'dir theg pa kun gyi rtse mo thig le gsang ba'i skor gyi don khrid la gsum ste/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa/ gtsigs che ba bka' rgyas gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni dpal kun tu bzang pos/ rdo rje sems dpa' la bshad/ des slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje la/ des 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la/ des shṝ seng ha la/ des dzñā na sū tra la/ des bi ma mi tra la/ des nyang ting bzang po la/ des sbas blo gros dbang phyug la/ des 'bro rin chen 'bar ba la/ des gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal la/ des lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la/ des shang pa ras pa la/ des zab ston chos 'bar la/ des dam pa gyer zhig la/ des gnyen ston shes rab rtse mo la/ des mnyam med yon tan sgang gi sprul sku mched gnyis la/ des bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje la/ des bla ma dam pa ku ma rā dza la/ des klong chen rab 'byams la gnang ba'o/ / don gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro nyams su blang ba/ dngos gzhi rang ngo sprad pa/ rjes snang ba ji ltar bskyang ba'o/ /dang po la sems sbyong rnam pa bdun las/ dang po byin rlabs kyi sgo dbye ba mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sems sbyang ba ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ rang gi spyi bor padma nyi ma'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad thim pas bzhad yal le/ 'od dang 'od zer du khyil le ba'i mthar/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor bar bsam la/

yid kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba dang thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags te/ bla ma rin po che sems nyid rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ 'od gsal nang nas 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshig brjod la/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab nas/ bdag dang bla ma 'od du zhu nas gnyis su med par gyur pa'i ngang la dar cig glod de/ rmi lam sgyu ma'i tshul gyis bsngo bar bya'o/ /des ni byin brlabs lhun grub tu byung nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / gnyis pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa maṇḍal gyi rnal 'byor la sems sbyang ba ni/ lan gsum phyis la dbus su tshom bu gcig bkod dus/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas la sogs pa sprin phung gtibs pa tsam mdun gyi nam mkha' bzhugs par bsam la/ tshom bu lnga'am bdun la sogs pa bkod pa'i mthar dbus su me tog spungs te lan lngar 'bul ba ni rim pa ltar gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pas brgyan pa'i zhing khams thams cad/ rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ sman sna tshogs dang*/ dri sna tshogs dang*/ me tog sna tshogs dang*/ 'bru sna tshogs kyis gang bar bsams te/ rin chen maṇḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i spṛn/ /sman spos me tog 'bru tshogs rnam sbyar ba/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kun gang bar phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rgyal ba'i 'byor pas yongs gang shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i tshig brjod do/ /mthar bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa'i ngang nas bsngo ba byas pas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis myur du thob par byed do/ / gsum pa sgrib pa sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gyis sems sbyang ba ni/ skad cig gis pad zla'i dbus su rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/

g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i snying nang zla ba'i dbus su rdo rje dkar po tshon gang ba lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i mtha' skor du yi ge brgya pa dkar ser mar me 'bar ba lta bu'i 'od kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs te/ snang thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ sgra skad thams cad yi ge brgya par bsams la/ āoṃ badzra sa twa sa ma yā/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa tiṣṭha/ ṭi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarbaka rma su tsa me tsittaṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūṃḥ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ badzra ma me muñtsa/ badzrī bha wa/ ma hā sa ma yas twa āḥ zhes ci 'grub bzlas pa'i rjes la snang ba thams cad thugs ka'i hūṃ la bsdu/ hūṃ mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag la/ bsngo ba byas pas bskal pa 'bum phrag du mar bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag cing nyams chag thams cad bskangs nas/ sems nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / bzhi pa blo sna btsan thabs su bstungs ba la tshe mi rtag pa'i rnal 'byor la sems sbyang ba ni/ phyi nam zla'i 'gyur ldog / nang phung po'i dar rgud/ nyin mtshan skad cig gis 'gyur ba/ rgan rabs gzhon rabs 'das pa la sogs pa'i mi rtag pa'i rkyen du ma la bsam te/ bdag gi tshe mi rtag pa la blo sna sbyang ngo*/ /des ni gang la yang rtag mi thub pas chos la brtson 'grus me 'bar ba lta bu 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / lnga pa srid pa la skyo ba skyed pa 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rnal 'byor la sems sbyong ba ni dmyal ba tsha grang yi dwags bkres skom/ dud 'gro bkol spyod/ mi skye rga na 'chi/ lha ma yin 'thab rtsod/ lha 'chi 'pho ltung ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams bsams la/ bdag gis 'khor bar sngar yang lan mang du sdug bsngal de 'dra myongs/

de yang snying nas chos ma bsgrub na myong dgos/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi btson rar na gnas pa 'di lta bu mtshangs re che snyam pa snying thag pa nas bsams pas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la skyo bas snying nas thar pa bsgrub pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / drug pa theg chen lam du 'gro ba byang chub sems kyi rnal 'byor sems sbyang ba ni/ pha dang mas gtso byas pa'i 'khor ba na gnas pa'i sems can gyi sdug bsngal dang nyes pa bsams te/ pha ma yin pa'i blo bzhag nas bdag kho nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgodapar bya'o/ /bdag gi dge bas sems can thams cad bde bar gyur cig snyam pa nas/ pha ma ltar byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal las bral 'dod kyi snying rje dang*/ byang chub la 'god 'dod kyi sems gsum bsgom par bya'o/ /des ni ci byed thams cad theg chen gyi lam du 'gyur ba dang*/ sdig pa stobs chen 'joms pa dang*/ dge ba rlabs chen 'grub pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / bdun pa sems nyid rnal ma'i don la brtag pa rang bzhin gshis kyi rnal 'byor la sems sbyang ba ni/ da ltar gyi dran rigs sna tshogs su 'char ba 'di/ dang po gang nas byung*/ byung mkhan ji lta bu/ da ltar gar gnas/ gnas mkhan ji 'dra zhig /tha ma gang du 'gro/ 'gro mkhan gang lta bu/ snang ba'i yul rdul phran du brtags pas yul las sems byung nas 'gro ba 'dug gam/ gnas mkhan rang gi sems kyi skad cig ma brtags pas ngo bo ngos gzung*/ rtags dang mtshan ma/ dbyibs dang kha dog tu 'dug gam/ legs par dpyad pas gang yang ma rnyed par phyam phyal ba brjod mi shes pa'i ngang la song ba ni/ ka dag rang gnas kyi dgongs pa zhes bya ste/ gnad las ngo bo mngon du mthong bas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rten med ye grol du shes nas/ rang sems stong gsal du rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / de ltar sngon 'gro rnams la blo 'byongs pa shin tu gal che bas/

gzab la gdab cing mos gus dang brtson 'grus chen po nas dmigs pa re re la rab zhag bdun/ 'bring lnga/ tha ma gsum gsum bya'o/ / don gnyis pa dngos gzhi rang ngo sprad pa la gnyis te/ rig stong skye med la ngo sprad pa dang*/ 'od gsal lhun grub la ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ lta bas thag gcad/ sgom pas nyams su blangs/ spyod pas 'phrang bsal/ 'bras bu re dogs spang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang rig stong gsal yod med spros pa dang bral ba 'di yin te/ brtags pas ma rnyed/ rgyu mtshan gang du yang ma grub/ yin min brjod gzhi las 'das/ yod ces ngos gzung med kyang med ces phyang chad la ma song bar/ rig ge /sing nge*/ ye re/ wal le ba/ tha mal gyi shes pa rang sor gnas pa nam mkha' lta bu 'di yin no/ / gnyis pa sgom pas nyams su blang ba la/ rang gnas kyi shes pa la bcos bslad med par ngo sprad pa dang*/ rang shar gyi shes pa rang grol chen por ngo sprad pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni lus sems khong glod pas sems nyid spro bsdu med pa'i ngang la rig pa'i gdangs ma 'gags pa khong nas 'char ba la ngo sprad de/ dpe gsum/ rang bzhin lnga/ drod rtags rnam pa bzhi las/ dpe gsum ni/ phyi nang bar gsum gang du'ang rten med pa nam mkha'i sprin ltar gzhag pa/ rnam rtog 'phro 'du'i rtsol ba chad pas/ rig pa rang gnas su phyam gyis lus pa chu chad pa'i rang 'thag ltar gzhag pa/ rang gnas gshis kyi gnas lugs su shes pas rtsol sgrub re dogs kyi khur med pa las zin pa'i skyes bu ltar gzhag pa'o/ /rang bzhin lnga ni/ de ltar bzhag dus ngang la gnas pa/ dran pas zin pa/ rtog par mi 'gyus pa/ re dogs chad pa/ bying rgod med pa'o/ /drod rtags bzhi ni/ de ltar sgoms pas lus sems med pa snyam pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang 'dres nas phyam gcig pa snyam pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' bde'i ngang las 'bral mi phod pa snyam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das gang la'ang re dogs dang gnyis 'dzin med pa'i ye yin/

sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa 'di rang du 'dug snyam pa'i thag chod kyi shes pa gting nas skye ba'o/ /de dag la goms pa las spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan mi 'dod kyang 'byung ba yin no/ / gnyis pa rang shar rang grol du ngo sprad pa ni/ ngang dwangs gcig la bzhag dus rnam rtog dran rig sna tshogs su 'char tshad rjes med rang shar rang grol du ngo sprad do/ /dpe gsum/ rang bzhin lnga/ drod rtags bzhi las/ dpe gsum ni/ ngang dwangs sems kyi rol pa las byung zhing*/ rol pa sems nyid du grol ba chu bo la dba' rlabs thim pa ltar gzhag pa/ shar grol rjes med du yal ba chu la ri mo bris pa ltar gzhag pa/ rang gis rang grol ba sbrul gyi mdud pa ltar gzhag pa'o/ /rang bzhin lnga ni/ de ltar bzhag dus shar ba ngos zin pa/ rtog pa snga phyir ma mthud pa/ rang yal rjes med gsal dwangs sing bag dang bcas pa/ 'phro gnas gnyis su med pa'o/ /drod rtags bzhi ni/ de nyid goms pa las/ rtog pas sems gnas pa la mi gnod cing*/ rtog dang mi rtog mnyam pa dang*/ dug lnga skyes grol du dag pas zhen chags mkha' ltar zhi ba dang*/ thug phrad rjes med du grol bas rkyen ngan lam du slong ba dang*/ mnyam rjes ris med du 'dres pas sgom pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar gnas pa'o/ / gsum pa spyod pas 'phrang bsal ba las gnyis la/ ngang dwangs mnyam gzhag la gnas dus snang sems gnyis med du grol bas tshogs drug lhug pa la bslab pa dang*/ rjes snang bden med du shes pas yul snang bden med du grol ba sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ngang dwangs shar grol du sgom dus rang sems skye med du gnas pas dbang po drug gi yul/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang chos drug la 'dzin pa rang log ste/ rang sor snang la zhen 'dzin med par rang ngo sprad do/ / gnyis pa ni/ cir snang sgyu ma'i rmi lam la sogs par shes par bya'o/

/ de ltar spyod pa'i dpe gsum ni/ shes pa yul snang 'dzin med du thugs phrad rjes 'dzin med pa smyon pa ltar spyod pa/ snang la zhen 'dzin med pa sgyu ma ltar spyod pa/ blang dor re dogs med pa bu chung ltar spyod pa'o/ /rang bzhin lnga ni rnam par snang ba yul du mi rtog pa/ blang dor med pa/ thad kar chod pa/ rkyen khar mi 'chor ba'o/ /drod rtags bzhi ni/ de ltar spyad pas snang ba gang la'ang gtad med du 'char ba dang*/ zhes 'dod zad pa dang*/ dgag sgrub zhig pa dang*/ chos nyid las mi 'da' ba'o/ / bzhi pa 'bras bu rang rig rang grol la ngo sprad pa ni/ gong ltar bsgom zhing dpyad kyang dang po'i dus kyi shes pa rjes med du grol ba'i rang gnas ris med do/ /dpe gsum ni/ rang sa'i shes pa chos skur thag chod pa sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa ltar la bzla ba dang*/ rtsol sgrub mi dgos pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin ltar la bzla ba dang*/ blo bde chos nyid du shar ba ded dpon nor bu lon nas rang khyim na gnas pa ltar la bzla ba'o/ /rang bzhin lnga ni/ grol thog tu gnas pa/ bcos bslad med pa/ bya rtsol zad pa/ shugs kyi dal ba/ gting nas bde ba'o/ /nyams kyi drod rtags bzhi ni/ gang la'ang smon pa'i blo dang bral ba/ yin min gyi the tshom zad pa/ phyogs yan chos nyid dang mi 'bral ba/ re dogs sgrub blo dang bral ba'o/ /'di dag ni tshe 'dir nyams su len pa'i mthil yin no/ / don gnyis pa 'od gsal lhun grub la ngo sprad pa ni/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs/ 'khor 'das gyais tshul/ lus la ye shes gnas tshul/ de nyid sku gsum du ngo sprad tshul/ bar dor sgra 'od zer gsum dang ye shes kyi snang ba 'char tshul/ 'bras bu gdod mar grol nas sems can gyi don 'byung tshul rnams ni/ snyan brgyud 'bring po dang chen mo bzhin ngo sprad do/ / don gsum pa rjes snang ji ltar bskyang pa ni/ ngo sprad pa bzhin nyams su len pa la brtson par byed pa ste/

bying rgod dang mtshan 'dzin gyi 'khris ma zhugs par bsgom zhing*/ ye shes rang la gnas pa'i dgongs pa la yid ches par byas nas/ gzhan bar do yin pa'i 'du shes nyin mtshan thun bzhir bar do'i ngo sprad dang*/ gdams pa dran par bya ba la bslab bo/ / spyi don gsum pa gtsigs che ba bka' rgyas gdabs pa ni/ yi dam gyi sku'am gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag ste/ zhag re la nyams su len pa thun re ma mtha' na'ang nyams su mi len re/ gdams pa'i dpe dang tshig don gzhan la ston re/ zhes mna' bsgags so/ /snod ldan phan thogs pa la gtad rgya yang phyag len du mdzad de/ de ltar rab gsang snyan brgyud snying po'i don/ / snying phyung lag mthil dag tu bkod pa yis/ /skal ldan 'gro rnams byang chub la reg nas/ /ma lus nyer zhi sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /thig le mchog tu gsang ba las/ snyan brgyud chung ngu da lta ye shes rang snang zhes bya ba/ bi ma la'i thugs bcud theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)snyan brgyud chung ngu ye shes rang snang*/
